item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Repaint Only the Car

turns.text: Can you make the red car navy blue? Leave the rest of the photo alone.

item.tests: Tests targeted car recolouring while preserving the original vehicle, lighting and surrounding scene.

answer_sheet.New colour: Navy blue, retaining the original paint finish and reflections.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original wide framing and 16:9 aspect ratio; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Other changes or text: None. Leave everything except the red body paint unchanged.

must_haves: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.

turns.text: Could you change the red body paint on the red hatchback in this attached pic to navy blue? I’ve been wondering what it would look like in a different colour, so that’s why I’m asking. Please keep the original wide framing and 16:9 aspect ratio; free-tier resolution is fine. I’d like the original paint finish and reflections retained when you change the colour. Leave everything else in the photo unchanged, with no other edits or added text. I’m a little nervous about whether I’ll like the navy, but I’m curious to see it.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the navy version. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so no image was created.

**What I tried:** a single 640px edit at 16:9 with flux-2-klein. That's the cheapest image model on the free plan, at about 5 credits per image, so there's no cheaper setting to fall back to. The instructions asked it to:
- recolour only the red hatchback in front to navy, keeping its shine and reflections
- leave everything else unchanged, including the red car parked in the background
- keep the wide framing and add no text

**To get it done:**
1. Add credits to your Magic Hour account, either by waiting for your free credits to refill or by buying a credit pack.
2. Tell me when that's done and I'll run the same request again, then send you the download link.

One heads-up: your photo is about 5:3, a bit taller than 16:9. To fit 16:9, the edit may trim a small strip from the top or bottom.
